Telemetry displays live values on the Driver Station screen.

Use telemetry.addData("label", value) to add a line.

At the end of loop(), you must call telemetry.update() to show the telemetry on the screen.

Add another line: telemetry.addData("Status", "Running");

You can display as many pieces of data as you want. Each addData() adds a line. No hardware needed.
